about_short_description.short_description: New Incentives is a non-profit that changes the lives of the world’s poorest mothers and newborns.

product.name: Cash Incentives for Childhood Vaccinations
product.description: New Incentives provides financial incentives to caregivers for vaccinating their infants, aiming to increase vaccination rates.

product.name: Vaccination Coverage Surveys
product.description: The organization conducts surveys to measure vaccination coverage and impact of their cash incentive program in targeted areas.

product.name: Randomized Controlled Trials (RCTs)
product.description: New Incentives evaluates the effectiveness of their cash incentive program through independent RCTs, measuring increases in vaccination rates and other impacts.

product.name: Expansion and Scale-Up Plans
product.description: Plans for expanding the reach of their cash incentive program to cover more regions and infants, aiming to increase vaccination rates further.

product.name: Financial Performance and Efficiency Metrics
product.description: New Incentives monitors and reports on key financial performance indicators, including cost per infant served by their program.
